versions.changelog:
Development build 16 since 2.0.0, on the way to 2.0.1, from dev (7448313): Start 2.0.1: version and Unreleased changelog section

For testing. Install it from the development plugin repository, used instead of the release one: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raetha/Jellyfin.Plugin.IFDB/refs/heads/manifest/manifest-dev.json

### Changed
- Updated the HtmlAgilityPack page-parsing library to 1.13.

### Behind the scenes
- More thorough tests: a newer coverage tool found conditions only ever tested one way, and they're now tested both ways.
- Development builds are numbered from the latest release (`2.0.0.15` is build 15 since 2.0.0), so each release counts as newer than the dev builds before it. Servers can keep the release and development repositories configured together.
- CI uses current GitHub Actions versions and a fixed Ubuntu runner image; CodeQL findings in the release scripts are fixed.

name: IFDB
description: Fetches metadata and images for fanedits from fanedit.org: title, synopsis and changes, fan editor, original film, genres, fanedit type, release date, runtime, ratings, posters, backdrops and trailers. Matches automatically during library scans.
overview: Movie metadata for fanedits from the Internet Fanedit Database (IFDB)
